title: Link Preview API
summary: Free API to get Open Graph data, title & images for any URL
content: Link Preview API: Free API to get Open Graph data, title & images for any URL | Product Hunt Launching today Link Preview API Launching today Free API to get Open Graph data, title & images for any URL 210 followers Free API to get Open Graph data, title & images for any URL 210 followers Visit website Unified API Completely free. Get back everything you need to render a rich link card in your app – the kind you see in Slack, iMessage, or Twitter when someone pastes a link. Dedicated handling for popular websites like YouTube, Amazon, Twitter, Airbnb, SoundCloud, NYT, Vimeo, Giphy, and more. These return reliable, high-quality previews every time. Built in image validation, and JavaScript rendering. Works directly from the browser, no proxy server required. Free usage up to 20,000 link previews. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team Awards More Free Launch tags: API • Developer Tools • Data Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 5 Day Rank Upvote • 186 points Follow Link Preview API Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info exabase.io/tools/link-preview Link Preview API Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/link-preview-api Similar Products Context.dev One API to scrape, enrich, and understand the web. 4.9 ( 8 reviews ) Firecrawl The Web Data API for AI Agents and Developers 5.0 ( 14 reviews ) Browser Automation LLM Developer Tools microlink.io Turn any website into data 5.0 ( 2 reviews ) Data analysis tools The OG Twitter Killed Link Previews. We're bringing them back. 4.8 ( 5 reviews ) Graphic design tools Social media management tools ScreenshotOne The Screenshot API you can finally rely on. 5.0 ( 5 reviews ) Unified API Cloud Computing Platforms View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment johnny makes ⚡️ Fabric Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm Johnny, founder of the team behind the Link Preview API. We built this because for such a simple thing, it's extremely tedious and painful to cover all of the weird edge cases on the internet, and it shouldn't be something you need to pay for when starting out. So we decided to make something radically simple... and completely free , up to 20,000+ requests per month. Just send a GET request with any URL and get back everything you need. Get structured JSON with the title, description, og:image, favicon, image dimensions, and site name. We handle all of the headache-inducing proxy-rotation, JavaScript rendering and more, including purpose-built integrations for YouTube, Amazon, Twitter, and a fair few other sites that need special treatment. Link Preview is part of the broader Exabase platform, so the same API key also gets you full page extraction, document parsing, and deep search if you ever need to go further. But it works perfectly well on its own. Thanks for taking a look – I'll be here all day to answer your comments! Johnny Upvote (2) Report Share

content: Eodly: Know what your team actually shipped today | Product Hunt Launching today Eodly Launching today Know what your team actually shipped today 101 followers Know what your team actually shipped today 101 followers Visit website AI Chief Of Staff Eodly reads Slack, Telegram, Discord, GitHub and Linear, and sends founders one sourced page each evening: who shipped, who's quiet, who's slipping, and any status that doesn't match reality. Your team never logs in. A chief of staff, not surveillance. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team More Free Options Launch tags: Productivity • Task Management • Artificial Intelligence Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 15 Day Rank Upvote • 109 points Follow Eodly Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info eodly.io Eodly Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/eodly Similar Products Spoke.ai Communicate better, build faster. 5.0 ( 19 reviews ) Slack apps Project management software Typo Better Code. Faster Deployments. Productive Dev Teams! 5.0 ( 25 reviews ) Engineering & Development Project management software theGist Get theGist of your work! 4.9 ( 13 reviews ) Productivity Slack apps Gryzzly Time and budget Tracking Effortless time tracking for your team and projects 5.0 ( 10 reviews ) Time tracking apps AI Chatbots Current Shared visibility for your team’s most important work 5.0 ( 7 reviews ) Productivity Project management software View more Subscribe Sign in Social LinkedIn X Framer AI Agents Design and publish professional sites with AI Try Framer AI Agents Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Juwon Adebayo Eodly Maker 📌 I run small teams and kept discovering slippage on Friday, when it was already too late. Nobody can read every Slack thread, PR, and ticket in real time. So I built Eodly: it reads where work already happens and sends one sourced evening page, who shipped, who's quiet, who's slipping, and any status claim that doesn't match the system of record. The team never logs into anything new, no screen capture, no keystroke logging, ever. It's a chief of staff for the founder, not surveillance. It also verifies KOL/ambassador deliverables and gates their payouts on proof, at $9 a campaign instead of a $2,000/mo platform. Upvote (2) Report Share 6d ago Gal Dayan different angle from the team-morale question above: what about false positives on the "status doesn't match reality" flag specifically. someone could be genuinely blocked on a design review that's happening in a call, or deep in research that doesn't produce commits or messages for two days, and that would look identical to actual slipping from the outside signals you're reading. does the founder get any confidence level on those flags, or is it presented as flat fact each evening? seems like the credibility of the whole digest hinges on that ratio being low Upvote (1) Report Share 21h ago Juwon Adebayo Eodly Maker @galdayan Exactly the failure mode we built against, so good question. The flag isn't "no signal = slipping.
